parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of inherited attributes not being recognized by autodoc. It iterates through the method resolution order (MRO) of the class to find inherited attributes.

issues.description: The code could be slightly more readable by adding comments to explain the purpose of iterating through the MRO and handling attributes.
